answer: An AI economy can resist Sybil attacks via a resource-staking mechanism, where each agent must commit a quantifiable amount of real-world assets to participate. This creates an 'oasis' of trust, as attackers cannot replicate the 'velvet' cost of acquiring and maintaining such stakes without disproportionate resources. The 'fable' of the system lies in its design, ensuring that creating fake identities becomes economically unfeasible, thus aligning incentives and preserving network integrity.
